title: Generic HUD notification lifecycle with MissionId is not mission progress evidence
action: HUD notification add/next/fade/remove lifecycle includes a mission-shaped identifier

sensitivityHandling.notes: Mission-shaped identifiers are synthetic and not proof of mission lifecycle.

expectedNonEvents.reason: A MissionId on a generic HUD lifecycle line does not prove acceptance.
Notification lifecycle transitions are UI behavior, not objective-state evidence.
No completion outcome, reward, or terminal mission state is present.

correlation.notes: Repeated Next/StartFade/Remove records should not duplicate or promote a domain event.

knownLimitations: Mission lifecycle promotion requires issue #10 evidence.
verificationNotes: Parser tests should retain this as negative evidence and keep Mission UI unsupported/unknown.
